en.html:
護氏"A golden god sleeps beneath the earth... and when the time of summons comes, will appear in our world."
護氏"An Emishi belief, was it not?"
Muramasa"............"
護氏"What do you think?"
Kageaki"...Sir?"
護氏"This belief in a god beneath the earth. Seeing a sanctuary deliberately constructed underground... perhaps even so fanciful a legend does not deserve to be laughed out of consideration."
護氏"Would you not agree?"
Kageaki"Indeed, sir. Precisely as you say."
護氏"Huhuhu..."
Kageaki"...?"
護氏"Are you not a priest of this shrine? To acceptaccept a layman's notions so meekly, without a word—what becomes of your professional standing?"
Kageaki"...You humble me."
護氏"If you have an opinion, let us hear it."
Kageaki"............Then, with your permission."
護氏"Granted."
Kageaki"According to one theory, Hachiman was originally a god brought from overseas... and thus has the character of a guardian of those seeking a new land."
護氏"Oh...?"
Kageaki"The Hachiman faith may also be understood as taking that form of expression here."
護氏"The Lower Shrine, built in the alien space underground, symbolizes the new world Hachiman brings. Is that your meaning?"
Kageaki"Indeed."
護氏"As expected of a professional. You know your subject well."
Kageaki"To parade my shallow learning before you is a matter of considerable embarrassment, sir."

護氏 「金色の神は地の底に眠り…… 　いつか招きの時が来たならば、我らの世へ 現れると」
護氏 「蝦夷どもの信仰であったかな」
村正 「…………」
護氏 「どう思う」
景明 「……はっ？」
護氏 「地の底に神在りとする信仰よ。 　かような祭殿がわざわざ地下に建てられて あるを見れば……荒唐無稽な伝承もあながち 笑い捨てにしたものではないやもしれぬ」
護氏 「そう思わぬか」
景明 「はっ。 　御意にございます」
護氏 「ふっふふ……」
景明 「……？」
護氏 「貴様はこの社の神官ではないか。 　素人考えを諾々と容いれ、一言も申さずでは、 立場に関わろう」
景明 「……畏れ入ります」
護氏 「意見あらば、言うてみよ」
景明 「…………では。 　お許しを得まして」
護氏 「うむ」
景明 「一説によりますれば、八幡神の原本は渡来 の神であり…… 　従って、新しき国を求める人々の守護神と いう性格が存在するとか」
護氏 「ほう……」
景明 「その八幡信仰が、かような形で表現された ……とも考えられますかと」
護氏 「地下という異空間に造られた下宮は、八幡 神がもたらす新世界を象徴するもの。 　そういう事か」
景明 「御意」
護氏 「流石に本職。 　良く存じておるのう」
景明 「御前にて浅学をひけらかし、汗顔の至りで ございます」

護氏"So Prince Maidono has a fighting man of your quality under him."
Kageaki"..."
護氏"Did loyalty make you accept an assassin's commission? Or was the reward sufficient?"
Kageaki"..."
護氏"A little late to take refuge in silence. Chirp something."
Kageaki"...Then I have a question for the Grand Commander of the Six Guards."
護氏"Oh? The assassin proposes to question me?"
Kageaki"There is one question a ruler must answer, whoever puts it to him."
護氏"Speak."
Kageaki"What sort of sovereign are you?"
護氏"————"
Kageaki"What do you intend for Yamato? What do you intend for its peoplepeople of the land?"
Kageaki"What kind of king are you? ...I ask for your answer."
護氏"Huh, huh."
Kageaki"..."
護氏"Unfortunate for you, assassin. I have no answer to that question."
Kageaki"What?"
護氏"I am solelysolely a conqueror."
護氏"Take everything. Conquer it. Make it submit. That is Moriuji Ashikaga."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Then dominion・・・ itself is your only aim? You have no interest in governing?"
護氏"Not none. It is a means of further conquest... That is all."

護氏 「皆無、とは云わぬが。 　征服を進める手段よの……所詮」

護氏"Six years ago was different. Whatever I did, there was no prospect of victory. That is why I chose submission."
護氏"But Rokuhara is no longer what it was. This time we can win. The land may be devastated, half the people may be sacrificed—but win we shall!"
Kageaki"...Madness."
護氏"Hm...?"
Kageaki"Half the people? A victory bought at that price has no meaning!"
Kageaki"Even if you drive the occupation forces out, Yamato itself will collapse..."
護氏"Very likely."
Kageaki"...!?"
護氏"No matter."
Kageaki"You would deliberately seek a victory that leaves nothing?"
護氏"Something remains. The fact that I conquered Yamato."
Kageaki"............"
護氏"What happens afterwards does not interest me."
Kageaki"Grand Commander... You would... for that alone—"

「六年前とは違う。あの時は如何にしようと
勝つ目が無かった。
　だから恭順の道を選んだ」



護氏
「しかし今の六波羅は昔日のそれではない。

犠牲となるやもしれんが、必ず勝つ！」



景明
「……馬鹿な」



護氏
「ふん……？」



景明
「民の半分？
